## Type of change

- [ ] feat (new feature)
- [ ] fix (bug fix)

- [ ] breaking change

## Checklist

- [ ] One thing per PR (atomic), with a clear description above
- [ ] Conventional Commit title (`feat:`, `fix:`, …)
- [ ] Commits are verified (signed)
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing
- [ ] Lint/format clean
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased** (if user-facing)
- [ ] No secrets committed
- [ ] No AI author or `Co-Authored-By` trailer; no em dashes
